title: PD 1096 Rule VII: TGFA, AMBF, and Location Controls

claims.claim_text: No building shall be constructed unless it adjoins or has direct access to a public space, yard, or street on at least one side.
claims.article_location: The rule that decides the answer
claims.sme_notes: Verified against raw DPWH PDF p.81, Rule VII Section 704 Location on Property.

claims.claim_text: Eaves over required windows shall not be less than 750 mm from side and rear property lines.
claims.article_location: The rule that decides the answer
claims.sme_notes: Verified against raw DPWH PDF p.81, Rule VII Section 704.1(c). The council concern that this belonged to Rule VIII was checked against the source and rejected for this local PDF.

claims.claim_text: Allowable Maximum Total Gross Floor Area shall only be as allowed under Rule VII.
claims.article_location: Do not collapse TGFA into footprint
claims.locator: Rule VII / Section 705.1-2 and Table VII.1 / PDF pp.83-84
claims.sme_notes: Table reference added for TGFA precision.

claims.claim_text: AMBF is a footprint/PSO control separate from TGFA; firewall conditions can modify the allowable footprint analysis under the Rule VII and Rule VIII cross-checks.
claims.sme_notes: Reworded to avoid implying AMBF is itself only a firewall control; raw source frames it as building footprint and firewall requirements cross-checked against Rule VIII and Fire Code conditions.
